items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: he wanted to know about Bud Livingston. I said well, look, I gave him all the information I had

ctx.x: You didn't get anything from it.
I didn't get anything from it.

Now, recently Time-Life has -- they're going to do a Beiderbecke thing and they hired Sudhalter (Phonetic) and they hired some other guy from the United Nations and he came up here. Then they got a lot of material -- the last time Sudhalter called up and he wanted to know about Bud Livingston. I said well, look, I gave him all the information I had, and I said, 'Hey, you're working for a big outfit -- at that time I would have loved to have something like that -- I said, 'Don't they pay anything for some of this…
